sample_mapping_evidence: Original GEO biological specimen records and source donor IDs; all repeated patient IDs stay linked.  "Original HF scRNA subseries: eight HF patients and three controls; other in vitro and animal experiments in parent study excluded. Custom hg38 plus lncipedia 5.2 gene universe retained."

source_metadata.access: Public GEO processed count matrices; controlled raw sequence access not required

title: PBMCs, Control, 1
growth_protocol_ch1: PBMC collection: Control and patient blood was collected in EDTA monovettes and processed immediately. Specifically, blood was diluted in PBS (ThermoFisher, #10010023) and layered onto Histopaque®-1077 (Sigma-Aldrich, #10771). Tubes were centrifuged for 30 min at room temperature, 800 g, brake and speed-up 1, and PBMCs were collected from the interphase between Histopaque®-1077 and plasma. PBMCs were washed five times with PBS, counted and frozen at -80°C in a 1:1 mixture of resuspension (40% FBS in RPMI) and 2x freezing medium (30% DMSO in RPMI containing 40% FBS) according to 10x Genomics demonstrated protocol #CG00039. The next day, PBMCs were transferred to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
extract_protocol_ch1: Single cell preparation and barcoding: PBMCs were thawed according to 10x Genomics demonstrated protocol #CG00039 and a cell concentration of 700 to 1,200 PBMCs per µl of PBS + 0.04% BSA was set. Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3ʹ GEM, Library & Gel Bead Kit v3.1 (10x Genomics, #PN-1000128, Chip G: #1000127) was used to generate GEMs, reverse transcribe RNA and amplify cDNA according to manufacturer’s instructions. Targeted cell recovery was 10,000.

Library construction and sequencing: After cleanup (step 2.3), 2 µl of the cDNA was used for quality control on the Agilent fragment analyzer (DNF-473 Standard Sensitivity NGS Fragment Kit). In addition, 10 µl of the cDNA was used as input for step 3 of the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3´ Reagent Kit to perform fragmentation, end-repair, A-tailing and adapter-ligation. The finished library was monitored again using the fragment analyzer and the DNF-473 Standard Sensitivity NGS Fragment Kit. Equimolar amounts of each sample were plexed at 1.25 nmol/l. Sequencing was performed as paired-end 2x150bp (S4-Flowcell) on a Novaseq 6000 (Illumina).
data_processing: Fastq files generated by bcl2fastq (version 2.20.0.422) were processed with cellranger count (version 6.1.1) against the human hg38 reference including lncipedia_5_2 transcripts.
Assembly: Reference transcriptome consisting of: human hg38 and lncipedia 5.2
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files
